senses.def: an African wild animal like a horse with black and white stripes
ex: We saw a herd of zebras on the plain.
A zebra has stripes on its body.

senses.def: a metal or plastic fastener with two rows of teeth used on clothes and bags
ex: The zip on my jacket is broken.
She closed the zip of her bag.

senses.def: an area that is different from the areas around it in some way
ex: Few people live in the war zone.
The zoologist studied the behaviour of wild monkeys.
She works as a zoologist at the national park.

senses.def: the scientific study of animals and their behaviour
ex: He is studying zoology at university.
She has a degree in zoology.

senses.def: a camera feature that makes distant objects look closer
ex: The camera has a powerful zoom.
Use the zoom to see the bird.
